mapping.author: claude-mapper-m3
mapping.draft_py:
# FDN Bloodtithe Collector: "Flying. When this creature enters, if an opponent lost life this
# turn, each opponent discards a card."
# Event: the compiler's "When this creature enters". The intervening "if" is the condition
# (CR 603.4), M20 Savage Gorger's verified "if an opponent lost life this turn":
# EVENT_THIS_TURN over LifeLostEvent(actor=an opponent), count 1. Effect: each opponent discards
# a card in M20 Yarok's Fenlurker's verified EachPlayer(ALL_OPPONENTS, hand move) form, the
# rotated opponent choosing from their own hand, to the graveyard (FDN Burglar Rat's note says
# why not Bad Deal's plural role).
etb = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    ),
    condition=FAtom(
        pred=FAtomPred.EVENT_THIS_TURN,
        count=QConst(value=1),
        event=LifeLostEvent(
            actor=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.OPPONENT),
        ),
    ),
    effect=EachPlayer(
        ref=ControllerRef.ALL_OPPONENTS,
        effect=A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
            'cards': Selector(
                count=QConst(value=1),
                mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                filter=FAnd(children=()),
                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
            ),
            'controller': ControllerRef.YOU,
            'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
            'from': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        }),
    ),
)
abilities = [etb, *compiled]

mapping.notes: Intervening 'if' as the condition: Savage Gorger's verified EVENT_THIS_TURN over LifeLostEvent(actor an opponent). The discard is Yarok's Fenlurker's EachPlayer(ALL_OPPONENTS, hand move) form to the graveyard (Arbiter of Woe's note says why not Bad Deal's). Flying compiles. Packs: tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/bloodtithe_collector_after_combat_damage_the_opponent_discards.json, tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/bloodtithe_collector_no_life_lost_no_discard.json, tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/bloodtithe_collector_your_own_life_loss_is_not_enough.json.

clauses.evidence: [cast]: 'keywords +FLYING' and the static section 'card keywords: FLYING'; [stimulus: this creature attacks and opp_giant blocks it]: no DECLARE_BLOCKERS row and 'opp is dealt 3 damage (combat) (by card/DEAL_DAMAGE)': the non-flying, non-reach Giant could not block it (contrast the creatures without flying, where the same variant shows 'DECLARE_BLOCKERS opp_giant card, 1').

clauses.clause: When this creature enters, if an opponent lost life this turn, each opponent discards a card.
clauses.evidence: In [cast] and in 'from your hand, the card enters during the opponent's turn' no opponent had lost life this turn, so the intervening 'if' was false and the trace shows no trigger and no discard (the 'you lose 2 life' stimulus is run with the card already on the battlefield, so it cannot trigger an enters ability). The branch where the condition is true never runs in the trace. Packs G00_1 (a drain first, then one discard of the opponent's choice, asked of the opponent), G00_3 (combat damage counts), G00_6 (three players: every opponent discards, also the one who lost no life) cover the true branch; G00_2 (nobody lost life), G00_4 (only I lost life), G00_5 (life lost on an earlier turn) the false ones.
